title: Universal Boolean Turing machine
statement: For the fixed effective machine coding, choose a finite Boolean Turing machine $U$ that simulates every decoded machine with the following guarantees. For each code word $\alpha$, there is a constant $C$ such that every computation of the decoded machine on input $x$ that produces output $y$ in time $t$ is simulated by $U$ on the paired encoding of $\alpha$ and $x$, producing $y$ in time $C(t+1)$. Conversely, whenever $U$ on that paired input produces an output, the decoded machine on $x$ produces the same output in some finite time.
hypotheses_covered: For the forward implication: output $y$, time $t$, and a decoded-machine computation producing $y$ in time $t$
For the converse: an output produced by $U$ on the paired encoding
